title: flare/files-sweep/v1
description: How many files a sweep examined and deleted, and whether it stopped early.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

deleted.description: The files it deleted, which no version listed.

examined.description: The files it read from the bucket's list.

stopped_early.description:
Whether it stopped at 10,000 files before the end of the list; the
next run starts from the beginning of the list again.

undecided.description:
The files it left because the table or the bucket did not answer;
the next run examines them again.
